coverage.assessment: The chains from education purpose to twenty-year account, from London/Paris to the return, from Teutonic to the Niagara ratio, and from office law to Hay all hold. The begonia, Niagara and King setups survive in the partner chapters. The cut stateroom marvel only slightly thins 'double--even treble' (noted under voice).
Locations, dates and entrances are clear. Kipling via Henry James is retained. One first-draft referent became ambiguous: 'its pursuit' now lacks the money clause that anchored it.
Brice's quip, Lamar's formula and Hay's Boutwell exclamation are correctly attributed. The Lamar exchange loses its ironic reply beat, 'He was right; Mr. Adams did know all about it'.

The hedges ('perhaps', 'as far as Adams knew', 'still in doubt') survive. The ledger now asserts Hay was no better off without Hay's evidence. It also drops the qualifier that the window privilege 'had nothing to do with their writings'.

The figure's occasion stays unexplained and Adams's wife is never mentioned. However, the revision removes Adams's own minute scrutiny of the figure and his refusal to question its meaning. Those lines set his stance apart from the visitors who all demand a meaning.

Triads, semicolon chains and the closing punchline survive. The revision trims several distinctive beats: the Sinai wilderness image, Hay laughing 'at his own expense', the 'teacher is the worst criminal' line, and the second Teutonic marvel.

The contrasts hold: society versus government, consideration versus money, layman's ideals versus priest's faith, and railway content versus new education. The cut Hay/King party-loyalty contrast and the Granville comparison were authorized optional material.
All four dependencies are intact at both endpoints in this run's drafts. The Niagara gloss was added as instructed.

strengths: All eight verbatim passages survive, including the stable image, the Niagara ratio, and the 'dead men' closing punchline.
The silence about Adams's wife is preserved. The figure is left as 'made for him in his absence' with no gloss.
Brice's quip is correctly tied to Cleveland and then applied to Harrison, and the King Banker/frog-empire image is retained.
Hay's laughing 'also at himself for laughing' and the Boutwell exclamation keep Hay's character alive in the office section.
summary: The revision keeps the chapter's frame and every planned verbatim line. The silence about the Rock Creek figure is intact, and all four dependencies survive in the partner drafts. The revision cuts further into a first draft that was already compressed. The main cost is a key Rock Creek sentence: Adams studied every detail of the figure yet never questioned its meaning. Smaller losses fall on several comic and rhetorical beats and on Hay's side of the profit-and-loss ledger. A few first-draft residues remain: the cut Lamar punchline and an ambiguous 'its pursuit'. No must-fix breakage was found.
